initial_cache_policy: Warmness uncontrolled after image preparation; initial residency is measured. No global cache drop.
memory_label: Container cgroup memory (includes charged cache; not guest physical memory)
scope: one replay of fixed public tool actions; read/write, pinned dependencies, persistent-session and async adapters are declared in normalized-steps.json; no original model thinking gaps
latency_method: static C fork/wait timer around Bash

validation.scope: local artifact/smoke check only; recorded trajectory completion is independent of official benchmark correctness
validation.command:
set -e
export PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
cd /tmp/CompCert
./ccomp -version
printf 'int main(void) { return 6*7 == 42 ? 0 : 1; }\n' > /tmp/asbp_smoke.c
./ccomp /tmp/asbp_smoke.c -o /tmp/asbp_smoke
/tmp/asbp_smoke
